name: Oiji Mi
dinnerNote: Five-course prix fixe (à la carte in the bar and lounge)

menus.name: Five-course prix fixe
menus.note: Main dining room; a choice of dishes at most courses. The sea urchin Oiji Bowl adds $35. The bar and lounge also serve à la carte.

bookingOpens: Online on OpenTable. Tables in the main dining room and lounge open 30 days ahead, for parties of one to seven.
cancellation: Cancelling less than 24 hours before the booking costs $50 a guest. Tables are held for 15 minutes; call if running late.
walkIns: Most bar seats are kept for walk-ins, first come, first served. The bar and lounge serve the à la carte menu as well as the prix fixe.
groups: Parties of up to seven can book as normal; larger groups should email info@oijimi.com. The whole restaurant can be hired for up to 60 seated or 125 standing.
dressCode: No formal dress code. Guests are asked to dress for a nice night out.
children: Children are welcome, but there is no children's menu. The restaurant suggests booking the lounge, where dishes can be ordered à la carte.
duration: About two hours: the restaurant allows two hours for each party.
byob: Corkage is $75 a 750ml bottle, wine only (no spirits or soju), at most two bottles or one magnum a party, and not for wines on the restaurant's own list. Bringing a cake costs $10 a person.
